programmes.d: Capt. Jonathan Moss is heading deep into the Everglades backcountry taking the Cayo 173 through the winding mangrove tunnels to the home of countless snook and tarpon!
Part 2 of Captain Mike Anderson and Captain Ryan Rickard keeping count of their catch on an epic day of fishing in Steinhatchee, FL.
Capt. Jason heads to Louisiana to fish and duck hunt with his buddies Capt. Britt Ordes and Ryan Lambert.
Kyle and Jeff hunt wild pheasants in South Dakota with their friends from BOSS.
Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the venison that Michelin star chef Mark Robinson has to offer.
Captain Jared Raskob and guest Captain Jimmy Hendricks face challenges from sharks during a fishing trip; the pair adapts their techniques to successfully catch their target species.
Capts. Scott and Steve fill up their Yeti cooler to make a big run from Plantation Boat Mart in the 36' Invincible into the green Gulf waters, hoping to do battle with some sea monsters.
A peaceful day of reef fishing in Islamorada turns into a kingfish and yellowtail frenzy for Captains Scott and Steve.
It only takes three fish to fill the Yeti cooler when Capt. Scott kite fishes the top for wahoo and Steve pulls a big mutton snapper off the bottom.
Captains Scott and Steve take a long run into the Gulf from Stock Island to load their coolers with cobia and huge yellowtail snapper.
Captains Scott and Steve sail west of Key West to battle with big kingfish and end up with plenty of meat for the smoker.

Captains Steve Rodger and Scott Walker prove themselves to be among the top charter boat and tournament captains in offshore fishing; follow their journey to fishing destinations as they share the techniques that have driven their success.
Bouncing around in a Summit climber proves to be a risky tactic for Bryan Brown as he is able to get tight to the bedding area where five bucks are chasing one hot doe.

Join Mark Peterson as he journeys to his final destination in Namibia in pursuit of the elusive Damara Dik-Dik. These tiny antelope-famed for their large eyes and extremely shy nature-present a unique challenge even for a seasoned hunter.
When the Bay Point Billfish Open returns, the crew hops on board the Ellie B for some offshore competition and follows the event's dockside party.
Capt. Justin and Meredith's beautiful Panama City Beach morning is met with a slack tide, so a new path to redfish success is found under a popular bridge.
Highlighting the stories and people who have made the shooting sports and hunting lifestyle a part of their lives.

Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi-day deer camp; along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau.

Skyler keeps it incredibly fun for his young boys while introducing them to hunting; Jackson is trying to fill his early season Kansas tag during the youth portion of the season; although it's early, they weren't expecting any velvet bucks.
After not hunting Kansas for a couple of years Nate Flynn returns to the Sunflower State to hunt with his friend and client, Curt Wittman.
On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade and the crew head north to scout out, plan, and put in the plots to lay the groundwork for this falls hunting season in the Midwest!

Adam returns to Ohio with renewed determination after his Illinois success, setting his sights on a massive 10-point buck that's eluded him twice during the rut. Every moment counts as he pursues what could be the second giant of his dream season.
Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting; he makes dishes with his former "Master Chef" contestant, Alex.
A long season and no target bucks, Dean puts the time in to produce encounters while bowhunting Saskatchewan.
Explore the sacred experiences, emotions and rewards that come from pursuing wild game in wild places.
The WoodHaven crew hunt all across the country chasing the wild gobbling turkey, and hard rutting whitetail.
It's opening day of youth season in Alabama and Mike and Jacob are ready to work on some longbeards; right off the roost turkeys are in sight.

What happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.
Join Tyler Jordan, Brandon Sheppard and Brantley Richardson as they hit the woods in Georgia during the peak of the November rut! Then, Tyler heads to Kansas in search of big Midwestern bucks.
Realtree's Ben McDonald gets lucky again on his first sit in Nebraska; this time he rattles in an absolute big whitetail into Bow Range.
Michael Pitts is joined by competition caller and call-maker Anthony Virga, as well as Cole Barthel; it's the first hunt of the year for the Realtree Road Trips crew.

Tyler Jordan is hunting with Turkeys for Tomorrow sweepstakes winners Jaryd and Kelli Hurst; Kelli is after her first turkey and just needs a little luck; Ole Miss Athletic Director Keith Carter also makes a visit to Realtree Farms to hunt.
After a tough go at it in Oklahoma, Rigsby Stewart gets back to his home turf in East Georgia.
Realtree's Chipper Jones bow hunts Kansas whitetails during the late rut.
A look at why minerals are so important for the herd; Randy goes through the details of why he uses Big Tine mineral.
The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast-forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

Trenton makes a trip to Louisiana to fish with Theophile Bourgeois at the Cajun Vista Lodge. With an early rain delay, they took a tour of the lodge and learned about its long-standing family history before hitting the water for some redfish.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Captain Tony Young for a day of offshore fishing and free diving out of Islamorada, Fla.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head deep into the Everglades to target snook in the murky waters of Lake Ingraham.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor use Lowrance Active Target all day to locate fish, first targeting bridge tarpon, followed by unearthing a variety of species in Florida Bay's mullet muds.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor chase tarpon of all sizes around Florida Bay and throughout the Everglades.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor catch spotted sea trout and jacks on the grass flats and potholes of Florida Bay.
Mike fishes his home waters with special guest Leiza Fitzgerald from CCA Florida.
Targeting mid-winter walleyes with new Tungsten Buck-Shot Spoon from Northland!

Danny Pruitt travels around the country fishing in some of the nation's best kept secrets all while discovering the communities, culture, food, and the people that make each episode unique and entertaining.
As the pressure of opening his new store builds, Josh steps away from the chaos and returns to the water for a solo wade fishing trip - his first in years.
Captain Jared Raskob and Captain Jake Leon use a bay boat to navigate the back country waters; they target multiple species in a single trip to achieve a back country slam.
Captain Jared Raskob and his family go on a summer fishing trip in the Florida Keys; the family explores local waters together and shares their passion for the outdoors.
